subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this is a new user-facing Talk/Voice UX with session-state implications across companion apps, so automation should not choose the platform scope or permanent selector model on its own.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk picker first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and require real multi-agent Talk routing proof before expanding elsewhere.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one common Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Wait for Chat selector outcome
options.body: Defer Talk/Voice work until the Android Chat selector PR is repaired or closed, then reuse any accepted session-state model.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk picker first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and require real multi-agent Talk routing proof before expanding elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the completed TTS half versus the remaining Talk/Voice selection work and has the clearest product-context signal in the discussion.
